scope: Design contract for later integration only; this revision does not edit runtime game code.
input: current target static texture and name
already-resolved damage, final_hp and defeated state
actor ID, current weapon and unlocked form

target_lifetime.create_or_bind: Before opening the cinema popup, bind the actual current target.
target_lifetime.alive: Keep the same target visual present during preparation, travel, attack, impact, recovery and return. Do not use impact windows to toggle enemy visibility.
target_lifetime.hit: Render contact flash, slash/fire/arrow/magic and single HP-loss text ABOVE the target. Natural VFX occlusion is allowed; do not remove the enemy node or set its alpha to zero just to simulate impact.
target_lifetime.defeated: Only the resolved defeated branch may remove or fade the target after defeat feedback. End the cinema without actor return, following the confirmed earlier behavior.
target_lifetime.scene_exit: Release cinema-only references when the overlay closes. The actual game target lifecycle remains owned by combat logic.

hp: Receive pre-hit and final HP from combat logic, display that resolved change once, and never apply damage or repeat subtraction in game state. This HTML only computes illustrative display values.
identity: Actor ID + unlocked form selects the same costume, hair, proportions and equipment through attack, turn, run and final stance. The initial standing frame is reused for the settled final stance.
stationary_recovery: Bow and magic return to their exact initial standing frame once recovery is complete, and hold it to overlay close. No late-frame reversion.
effects: Runtime target may be any species and needs only a static sprite; attacks are generic overlays.
